claims.statement: For every ordinary arity-2,3,4 path-star at an actual eligible p, with x the least strict descent of P=C+zL^q including terminal zero extension, j=p-2, q=N+1, beta_x=binom(q,x)-binom(q,x-1)>0, the conditioned product-state drift D satisfies E_j D=(j+1)C[j+1]/C[j]-(q-j)<2j-N-(j+1)beta_x/C[x]. Selectors e0=1[Delta_p A0<0], ei=1[Delta_p Ai<0] and original multiplicities 1,ri remain at the same p but are not used in this bound.

claims.reason: The differential identity is exact; beta_x>0 follows from guards; division by C[x]>0 and decreasing ratios of the log-concave product C give the displayed strict bound. Boundary and interior substitutions pass. CT-U1 and CF-U1 are sound at this informal grade.

claims.reason: Copied producer replay returns 4308 profiles and no upward discrepancy. Independent exact boundary/interior checks support sign handling. The finding is finite and does not justify a universal unconditioned substitution.

claims.reason: Independent monomial expansion GF4=(3,9,7,2), direct coefficient multiplication and layer summation match; exact signed margins and relevant coefficients are in own JSON. CT-U2 and CF-U2 correctly avoid claiming failure of full payment.

claims.reason: Independent layer sum agrees with full product coefficient; K=delta C[j]-(delta-1)C[j+1]>0 makes nonnegative layers increase the margin. Exact depth margins are recorded. CT-U2 and CF-U2 preserve the bounded grade.
